title: Wrongful decline (hero)
summary: Ridge tiles displaced with water ingress. A TPA desk adjuster declined citing 38 mph and mortar deterioration, on two undated ground-level photos. The insurer's burden on the exclusion looks undischarged.

title: Defensible decline
summary: Kitchen flat roof water ingress. A field surveyor declined with six dated photos showing ponding, sagging decking, a prior patch repair and moss. Causation is reasoned.

title: Source unavailable
summary: Ridge tile displacement at a rural property. No weather station within 15 km, so storm conditions at the postcode cannot be confirmed from the file.
